name: manual_61d251
claim: When two PRs pin each other's commits, merge the one whose commit is pinned with a merge commit, never a squash, so the pinned SHA stays reachable from main.

decisions.notes: oramasys#75 merged as a merge commit and phylax#19 kept pinning its first commit; a squash would have left the pin pointing at an orphaned commit.

rationale: oramasys#75 merged as a merge commit and phylax#19 kept pinning its first commit; a squash would have left the pin pointing at an orphaned commit.
